newsitem.title: CHINA: Pudong exports $2.3 billion, up 9 pct by September.
newsitem.headline: Pudong exports $2.3 billion, up 9 pct by September.

text.p: Exports from the Pudong development zone in Shanghai were up 9.11 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from the same 1995 period, the official Business Newspaper said on Thursday.
Exports from foreign-funded firms in the zone surged 67.4 percent, it added.
Pudong exported $2.3 billion worth of goods in the first nine months of 1996, accounting for 23.3 percent of the city's exports in the same period, the newspaper said.
Foreign-funded firms in Pudong exported $360 million in the nine months, up 67.4 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
